name: Luck Blade

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Luck
powers.text: Reroll one of your attack rolls, ability checks or saving throws (used on a failure; once per dawn).

powers.name: Wish
powers.text: Spend a charge to cast Wish. The blade doesn't regain charges.

summary: +1 sword, +1 to saving throws while you carry it, a daily reroll, and 0-3 wishes.
text: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws. Luck. If the weapon is on your person, you can call on its luck to reroll one attack roll, ability check or saving throw you dislike; you must use the second roll. This property can't be used again until the next dawn. Wish. The weapon has 1d4 - 1 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Wish from it. This property can't be used again until the next dawn. The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.
